targets.question: Does evidence for Saladin as ruler of Egypt justify Cairo as a locality control point at end of 1187?
targets.stop_condition: Stop after direct chronicles and two scholarly syntheses fail to name Cairo for this role.
targets.success_criteria: A source names Cairo as a relevant political or operational center for the exact slice.

targets.question: Can adjacent 1131 evidence support an Edessa control point for the 1130 slice?
targets.stop_condition: Stop when direct 1130 evidence is found or the strongest accessible accounts only support 1131.
targets.success_criteria: A source resolves the one-year bridge or provides direct 1130 evidence.

targets.question: Which inland settlements, fortresses, routes, or exclusions can constrain the County of Tripoli hypothesis around 1130?
targets.stop_condition: Stop after a bounded review of the principal narrative and two regional studies yields only the city title.
targets.success_criteria: At least one reviewed non-capital observation supplies a control point, route, frontier, or explicit exclusion.

targets.question: Was Ascalon controlled by Fatimid Egypt in the 1130 slice at a standard sufficient for a point-control input?
targets.stop_condition: Stop after two directly relevant scholarly or primary-source checks remain inconclusive.
targets.success_criteria: A page-addressable source directly supports or rejects locality control at the target slice.
